definitions.explanation: Equipment and implements used for cleaning, such as brooms, mops, dustpans, and buckets.

examples.japanese: {掃除用具|そうじようぐ}をしまう。
examples.english: To put away the cleaning tools.

examples.japanese: {掃除用具|そうじようぐ}は{廊下|ろうか}のロッカーに{入|い}れてある。
examples.english: The cleaning supplies are in the hallway locker.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}では{生徒|せいと}が{自分|じぶん}たちで{掃除用具|そうじようぐ}を{使|つか}って{教室|きょうしつ}を{掃除|そうじ}する。
examples.english: At school, students use cleaning tools to clean the classroom themselves.

notes:
A compound of {掃除|そうじ} (cleaning) + {用具|ようぐ} (tools/equipment). In Japanese schools, students are responsible for daily classroom cleaning, so {掃除用具|そうじようぐ} and the {掃除用具入|そうじようぐい}れ (cleaning supply cabinet) are familiar fixtures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {掃除用具入|そうじようぐい}れ: cleaning supply cabinet
- {掃除用具|そうじようぐ}を{揃|そろ}える: to gather cleaning supplies
- {掃除用具|そうじようぐ}を{片付|かたづ}ける: to tidy up the cleaning tools

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {清掃用品|せいそうようひん}: cleaning products — slightly more formal and broader, including chemical cleaners
- {掃除道具|そうじどうぐ}: cleaning tools — a near-synonym using {道具|どうぐ} instead of {用具|ようぐ}; both are interchangeable in everyday use
